steps.headline: Does the download setup now fit YouCoded's settings style?
steps.changed: The nested bordered project cards and handmade header have been replaced by the same settings rows YouCoded uses elsewhere. Each project expands to the newly downloaded plugin's switches.
steps.notice: Expand Personal or School notes; each project keeps its own choices. The first project's parts are open to show the structure without extra clicks.
steps.risk: This is a UI-only preview of the install setup. The sample plugin and projects are illustrative; the switches do not save, and the full Projects screen is not yet wired.
